verdict.rationale: Wave documents auto-importing, merging and categorizing bank transactions on the Pro plan. That is an adjacent bookkeeping automation, not an agent that reconciles a month end-to-end, flags exceptions, and prepares the close for human review. The live GraphQL endpoint is only a developer building block with no documented reconciliation surface, and the public pages document no agent, MCP, or API workflow for this story.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent reconcile a month end-to-end, matching transactions, flagging exceptions, and preparing the close for human review
